description_en: Modifies the backup policy settings of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS实例的备份策略设置
name: ModifyBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

DataBackupPolicy: data backup.
LogBackupPolicy: log backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型，取值：

DataBackupPolicy：数据备份
LogBackupPolicy：日志备份
parameters.name: backup_policy_mode

parameters.help_en: The time period during which the backup task is executed. Format: HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ (UTC). This parameter is required when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy. This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh: 执行备份任务的时间。格式：HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 BackupPolicyMode为DataBackupPolicy时，该参数必传。 仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: preferred_backup_time

parameters.help_en:
The backup cycle. You must specify at least two days. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:
Monday: Monday.
Tuesday: Tuesday.
Wednesday: Wednesday.
Thursday: Thursday.
Friday: Friday.
Saturday: Saturday.
Sunday: Sunday.

This parameter and the BackupInterval parameter determine the backup policy together. For example, if you set this parameter to Saturday and Sunday and set the BackupInterval parameter to 30 minutes, a backup is performed every 30 minutes on Saturdays and Sundays.
This parameter is required when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
备份周期。至少需要指定2天，多个取值用英文逗号（,）隔开。取值：
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日

与BackupInterval参数共同决定备份策略。例如：本参数指定周六周日备份，BackupInterval参数指定30分钟，则在每周的周六和周日每隔30分钟执行一次备份。
BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时，该参数必传。
仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: preferred_backup_period

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which data backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730.

This parameter is required when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
数据备份保留天数，取值：7~730。

BackupPolicyMode为DataBackupPolicy时，该参数必传。
仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable log backup. Valid values:

Enable: enables log backup.
Disabled: disables log backup.

For ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances, log backup is enabled by default and cannot be disabled. However, you can modify the log backup frequency as follows:

Every 5 minutes: Set BackupLog to Enable and leave LogBackupFrequency empty. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2861729.html. This configuration is not supported when the preferred secondary instance is configured for backup (BackupPriority is set to 1). Otherwise, an error is reported.
Every 30 minutes: Leave BackupLog empty and set LogBackupFrequency to LogInterval.
Same as data backup: Leave both BackupLog and LogBackupFrequency empty.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy. It is used to enable or disable log backup
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启日志备份。取值：

Enable：开启。
Disabled：关闭。

对于SQL Server实例，日志备份默认开启，无法关闭，但您可以修改日志备份频率，具体如下：

日志备份频率为每5分钟一次：BackupLog设置为Enable，LogBackupFrequency为空（无需传值）。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2861729.html。**该配置不支持在设置了优先备库（BackupPriority为1）时使用，否则将会报错。**
日志备份频率为每30分钟一次：BackupLog为空（无需传值），LogBackupFrequency设置为LogInterval。
日志备份频率为与数据备份一致：BackupLog为空（无需传值），LogBackupFrequency为空（无需传值）。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为DataBackupPolicy时生效，用于开启或关闭日志备份
parameters.name: backup_log

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which log backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730. The value cannot be greater than the data backup retention period.

When log backup is enabled, you can specify the number of days for which log backup files are retained. This parameter is supported only for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances.
This parameter takes effect when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy or LogBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
日志备份保留天数。取值：7~730，且不大于数据备份保留天数。

当开启日志备份时，可设置日志备份文件的保留天数，目前仅支持MySQL和PostgreSQL实例设置该值。
BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy或LogBackupPolicy时都适用
parameters.name: log_backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable log backup for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL, ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, and ApsaraDB RDS for MariaDB instances. Valid values:
True or 1: enables log backup.
False or 0: disables log backup.

Instance log backup is enabled by default and cannot be disabled for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances. Therefore, you do not need to configure this parameter for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy. It is used to enable or disable log backup
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL、PostgreSQL、MariaDB实例是否开启日志备份。取值：
True或1：开启。
False或0：关闭。

SQL Server实例日志备份默认开启，无法关闭。因此SQL Server实例无需关注此参数。
该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，用于开启或关闭日志备份
parameters.name: enable_backup_log

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable point-in-time recovery (PITR) for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances. Valid values:
True: enables PITR.
False: disables PITR.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy and BackupLog is set to Enable. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2666046.html
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例是否开启任意时间点恢复。取值：
True：开启
False：关闭

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy且BackupLog为Enable时生效。功能详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2666046.html
parameters.name: enable_pitr_protection

parameters.help_en:
The number of hours for which instance log backups are retained locally on the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance. Valid values: 0 to 168 (7 × 24). A value of 0 indicates that log backups are not retained locally.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy. In this case, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例日志备份本地保留小时数。取值：0~7*24，0表示不保留。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，且此时该参数必传
parameters.name: local_log_retention_hours

parameters.help_en:
The maximum usage of the local log storage space on the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance. If the usage exceeds this value, the earliest binary log files are deleted until the usage drops below this value. Valid values: 0 to 50. The default value indicates that the parameter is not modified.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy. In this case, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例本地日志最大循环空间使用率，超出后，则从最早的Binlog开始清理，直到空间使用率低于该比例。取值：0~50。默认不修改。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，且此时该参数必传
parameters.name: local_log_retention_space

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to unconditionally delete binary log files when the storage usage of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance exceeds 80% or the remaining storage space is less than 5 GB. Valid values: Enable and Disable. The default value indicates that the parameter is not modified.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy. In this case, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例使用空间大于80%，或者剩余空间小于5 GB时，是否无条件清理Binlog。取值：Enable | Disable。默认不修改。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，且此时该参数必传
parameters.name: high_space_usage_protection

parameters.help_en:
The log backup frequency for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances. Valid values:
LogInterval: every 30 minutes.
Empty (no value required): every 5 minutes or the same as the data backup frequency.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server实例的日志备份频率，取值：
LogInterval：每30分钟。
空（无需传值）：每5分钟备份一次或与数据备份一致。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: log_backup_frequency

parameters.help_en:
The backup compression method. Valid values:
0: no compression.
1: zlib compression. The format is tar.gz.
2: parallel zlib compression.
4: QuickLZ compression. The format is xb.gz. This method applies only to MySQL 5.6 and 5.7. You can use this compression method to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/103175.html.
8: QuickLZ compression. The format is xb.gz. This method applies only to MySQL 8.0. Restoration of individual databases and tables is not supported.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
备份压缩方式。取值：
0：不压缩。
1：zlib压缩，格式为tar.gz。
2：并行zlib压缩。
4：quicklz压缩，格式为xb.gz。仅适用于MySQL 5.6/5.7，此备份压缩方式可用于https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/103175.html。
8：quicklz压缩，格式为xb.gz。仅适用于MySQL 8.0。暂不支持单库单表恢复。

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: compress_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which archived backups are retained. Default value: 0, which indicates that archive backup is disabled. Valid values: 30 to 1095.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
归档备份的保留天数。默认为0，表示未开启归档备份。取值：30~1095。

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: archive_backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of archived backups. The number of backups that can be retained within this period is determined by ArchiveBackupKeepCount. Default value: 0. Valid values:
ByMonth: month.
ByWeek: week.
KeepAll: all backups are retained.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
归档备份的保留周期，该周期内能保存的备份个数由ArchiveBackupKeepCount决定。默认为0。取值：
ByMonth：月
ByWeek：周
KeepAll：全部保留

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: archive_backup_keep_policy

parameters.help_en:
The number of archived backups to retain. Default value: 1. Valid values:
When ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy is set to ByMonth, valid values are 1 to 31.
When ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy is set to ByWeek, valid values are 1 to 7.

When ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy is set to KeepAll, you do not need to specify this parameter.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
归档备份的保留个数。默认为1。取值：
当ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy为ByMonth时，取值为1~31。
当ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy为ByWeek时，取值为1~7。

当ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy为KeepAll时，本参数无需传入。
仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: archive_backup_keep_count

parameters.help_en:
The data retention policy for archived backups of deleted ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances. Valid values:
None: no backups are retained.
Lastest: the last backup is retained.
All: all backups are retained.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy.
For a new ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL cloud disk instance purchased on or after February 1, 2024, the default value of ReleasedKeepPolicy is Lastest. For an instance with Premium Local SSDs, the default value is None. For feature details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2836955.html
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL已删除实例的归档备份保留策略。取值：
None：不保留
Lastest：保留最后一个
All：全部保留

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效。
2024年02月01日及之后新购的RDS MySQL云盘实例ReleasedKeepPolicy默认值为Lastest；高性能本地盘实例默认值为None。功能详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2836955.html
parameters.name: released_keep_policy

parameters.help_en:
The number of local binary log files to retain. Default value: 60. Valid values: 6 to 100.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy.
If the instance is an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance, you can set this parameter to -1, which indicates that the number of local binary log files to retain is not limited
parameters.help_zh:
本地Binlog保留个数。默认为60。取值：6~100。

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为LogBackupPolicy时生效。
如果实例类型为MySQL，可以传入-1，即不限制本地Binlog的保留个数
parameters.name: log_backup_local_retention_number

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable backup within seconds. Valid values:
Flash: enables backup within seconds.
Standard: disables backup within seconds.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启秒级备份。取值：
Flash：开启
Standard：关闭

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot backup frequency. Valid values:
15: 15 minutes.
30: 30 minutes.
60: 60 minutes.
120: 120 minutes.
180: 180 minutes.
240: 240 minutes.
360: 360 minutes.
480: 480 minutes.
720: 720 minutes.

This parameter and the PreferredBackupPeriod parameter determine the backup policy together.
The ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance must be a cloud disk instance running MySQL 5.7 or 8.0 of the high availability series or Cluster Edition.
The ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance must be a cloud disk instance.
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211143.html must be enabled for the ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance.
This parameter does not take effect when Category is set to Flash.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
快照备份频率。取值：
15：15分钟。
30：30分钟。
60：60分钟。
120：120分钟。
180：180分钟。
240：240分钟。
360：360分钟。
480：480分钟。
720：720分钟。

与PreferredBackupPeriod参数共同决定备份策略。
MySQL实例必须是云盘5.7、8.0 高可用系列、集群系列实例。
PostgreSQL实例必须是云盘实例。
SQL Server实例必须已开启https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211143.html。
Category参数为Flash时本参数无效。
该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: backup_interval

parameters.help_en:
The backup method for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances with cloud disks. Valid values:
Physical (default): physical backup.
Snapshot: snapshot backup.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server云盘版实例的备份方式。取值：
Physical（默认值）：物理备份
Snapshot：快照备份

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: backup_method

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable incremental backup for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances with cloud disks and ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances with local SSDs. Valid values:
False (default): disables incremental backup.
True: enables incremental backup.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server云盘版、MySQL本地盘实例是否开启增量备份。取值：
False（默认）：关闭
True：开启

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: enable_increment_data_backup

parameters.help_en:
The high-frequency incremental backup frequency for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances with local SSDs. Valid values:
60: 60 minutes.
120: 120 minutes.
240: 240 minutes.
360: 360 minutes.
720: 720 minutes.

This parameter takes effect only when EnableIncrementDataBackup is set to True
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL本地盘实例高频增量备份频率。取值：
60：60分钟。
120：120分钟。
240：240分钟。
360：360分钟。
720：720分钟。

该参数仅在EnableIncrementDataBackup参数为True时生效
parameters.name: inc_backup_interval

parameters.help_en:
The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95717.html option for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server Cluster Edition instances. Valid values:
1: prefer the secondary instance.
2: force the primary instance.
 
This parameter takes effect only when BackupMethod is set to Physical. If BackupMethod is set to Snapshot, backups are forcibly performed on the primary instance for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server Cluster Edition instances.
After you set this parameter to 1 (prefer the secondary instance), the 5-minute log backup policy (BackupLog is set to Enable and LogBackupFrequency is left empty) is not supported. Otherwise, an error is reported. Set the log backup frequency to every 30 minutes or the same as the data backup frequency
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server集群版实例https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95717.html的设置选项。取值：
1：优先备库
2：强制主库
 
仅当BackupMethod取值为Physical时，该参数才生效。如果BackupMethod设置为Snapshot，SQL Server集群版实例将强制在主库备份。
设置优先备库（BackupPriority为1）后，不支持开启5分钟日志备份策略（BackupLog为Enable且LogBackupFrequency为空），否则将会报错。请将日志备份频率设置为每30分钟一次或与数据备份一致
parameters.name: backup_priority

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the advanced backup policy. If you set this parameter to 1, both the advanced data backup policy and the advanced log backup policy are configured
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用高级备份策略。传入 1 时，同时设置高级数据备份策略和高级日志备份策略
parameters.name: enable_advanced_backup_policy

fields.help_en:
The operation on the sub-policy. Valid values:

CREATE: create.

UPDATE: update.
 
DELETE: delete
fields.help_zh:
对这条子策略的操作

CREATE：新增

UPDATE：修改
 
DELETE：删除
fields.name: action_type

fields.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

F: full backup.

L: log backup (used for SQL Server)
fields.help_zh:
备份类型

F：全量备份

L：日志备份（sqlserver
用到）
fields.name: bak_type

fields.help_en: The region ID of the destination region for data backup
fields.help_zh: 数据备份目标地域的地域代码
fields.name: dest_region

fields.help_en:
The type of the destination storage pool. Valid values:

level1: level-1 storage.

level2Cross: cross-region backup.

level2: intra-region backup
fields.help_zh:
目标存储池类型。

level1一级存储

level2Cross 跨地域备份

level2 同地域备份
fields.name: dest_type

fields.help_en:
The filter option. Valid values:

backupInterval: fixed interval.

dayOfWeek: fixed day of the week
fields.help_zh:
过滤选项

backupInterval
固定间隔

dayOfWeek固定每周备份
fields.name: filter_key

fields.help_en: The filter type. Valid value: crontab (periodic backup)
fields.help_zh: 过滤类型： crontab - 周期备份
fields.name: filter_type

fields.help_en:
The filter value for data backup. If the filter option is crontab, enter a cron expression.

When FilterKey is set to backupInterval, this value specifies the backup interval in minutes.

When FilterKey is set to dayOfWeek, this value specifies the day of the week for the backup
fields.help_zh:
数据备份的过滤条件值；当过滤项为 crontab 时，填写 cron 表达式。

当FilterKey 为 backupInterval 时，表示每 x 分钟备份一次

当 FilterKey 为 dayOfWeek 时，表示固定每周几备份
fields.name: filter_value

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to retain only one data backup per day
fields.help_zh: 是否每天仅保留一份数据备份
fields.name: only_preserve_one_each_day

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to retain only one data backup per hour
fields.help_zh: 是否每小时仅保留一份数据备份
fields.name: only_preserve_one_each_hour

fields.help_en:
The retention type. Valid values:

delay: fixed retention period.

never: long-term retention (LTR)
fields.help_zh:
保留类型

delay
固定保留时间；

never
长期保留
fields.name: retention_type

fields.help_en: The number of days for which data backups are retained. This parameter takes effect only when RetentionType is set to delay
fields.help_zh: 仅 RetentionType 为 delay 时有效，数据备份保留天数
fields.name: retention_value

fields.help_en: The region ID of the source region for data backup
fields.help_zh: 数据备份源地域的地域代码
fields.name: src_region

fields.help_en: The type of the source storage pool
fields.help_zh: 源存储池类型
fields.name: src_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the sub-backup policy
fields.help_zh: 子备份策略ID
fields.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_zh: 高级数据备份策略列表
parameters.name: advanced_data_policies

The operation on the sub-policy. Valid values:

fields.help_zh: 日志备份目标地域的地域代码

The type of the destination storage pool. Valid values:

 同地域备份

fields.name: enable_log_backup

The filter option. Valid values:

backupInterval: fixed interval.

dayOfWeek: fixed day of the week
fields.help_zh:
过滤选项：

backupInterval
固定间隔；

dayOfWeek
 固定每周备份

fields.help_en:
The filter value for log backup. If the filter option is crontab, enter a cron expression.

When FilterKey is set to backupInterval, this value specifies the backup interval in minutes.

When FilterKey is set to dayOfWeek, this value specifies the day of the week for the backup

日志备份的过滤条件值；当过滤项为 crontab 时，填写 cron 表达式。

当
 FilterKey 为 backupInterval 时，表示每 x 分钟备份一次

当
 FilterKey 为 dayOfWeek 时，表示固定每周几备份
fields.name: filter_value

fields.help_en:
The log retention type. Valid values:

delay: fixed retention period.

CompressType.description_en:
The backup compression method. Valid values:
0: no compression.
1: zlib compression.
2: parallel zlib compression.
4: QuickLZ compression. Database and table restoration is enabled.
8: QuickLZ compression for MySQL 8.0. Database and table restoration is not supported

EnableBackupLog.description_en:
Indicates whether log backup is enabled. Valid values:
1: enabled.
0: disabled.


Instance log backup is enabled by default and cannot be disabled for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances
